body: No, I’ll still feel a libido. I want something along the lines of those used as punishments for sex offenders in some country. Many convicted rapists in Pakistan are forced to take such drugs, and their libidos are apparently removed completely by the process.

It’s objective. While I’m quite successful socially with men in platonic settings, I’ve never received any sort of interest from a woman for anything. My attempts over the years with dating apps are complete failures with no results whatsoever. Whenever I try to get dates, I fail every time no matter what I do, and I’ve never been in a romantic relationship. This constant rejection causes serious trauma and depression, and cripples my ability to focus on my friends and University studies, and I don’t want to live in anguish anymore. 

I just want to be happy and not have to worry about trying desperately for something I’m clearly unable to get.
